parsed.evidence_quote:
Expression was induced at an O.D.600 of 0.8 by adding 200 μL of a 1 mM IPTG stock solution to 1 L of medium.
DSSO (Thermo Scientific, Darmstadt, Germany) was dissolved in DMSO yielding a concentration of 50 mM (stock solution). The proteins ... were cross-linked with a 3.3-fold excess of the DSSO in PBS buffer (pH 7.5). ... incubated for 1 h at 25°C.
For photo-reactive cross-linking proteins were expressed by E. coli in the presence of photo-leucine and photo-methionine ... For cross-linking ... irradiated with UV light of 365 nm for 30 min.
For ISD cross-linked proteins were reduced with DTT (5 mM) ... and alkylation with iodoacetamide (IAM, 10 mM ...). Samples were then digested with LysC ... with trypsin ...
